title: TTP Attack on Mangi Dam Police Post, Ziarat District Kills 9 Officers
detail: Militants attacked a police post guarding the Mangi Dam project in Ziarat district, Balochistan, on the night of July 6-7, 2026. Nine police officers, including two station house officers, were killed in a four-to-five-hour gunbattle. TTP claimed responsibility, part of the same early-July wave of attacks that prompted Operation Shaban.

title: Paigard News Director Jawid Niazi Released After Two Months in Taliban Custody
detail: Jawid (Ahmad Jawed) Niazi, director of the Paigard News Agency, was released from the Taliban General Directorate of Intelligence's 'Directorate 40' on July 6, 2026, after two months in detention (arrested May 6). No charges were ever specified. The Afghanistan Media Support Organization (AMSO) welcomed the release on July 7 but said a single release 'is not enough,' renewing calls for the Taliban to free all detained journalists. Separately, CPJ's case tracking indicates TOLOnews reporter Mansoor Niazi was held until June 24, 2026 and remains on bail awaiting trial on unspecified charges alongside colleague Imran Danish, with no trial date set as of mid-July.

title: UNDP-UNHCR: 2.7 Million Returnees Straining Afghanistan's Economy; 74% of Population Can't Meet Basic Needs
detail: A joint UNDP-UNHCR statement said 2.7 million returnees are straining Afghanistan's economy and public services, with 74% of the population — roughly 29 million people — unable to meet basic needs. UNDP Administrator Alexander De Croo and UNHCR High Commissioner Barham Salih made a joint visit to Jalalabad to meet earthquake-affected and returnee communities; the agencies project more than 570,000 Afghans will need third-country resettlement in 2026. Separately, KabulNow reported 253 families (1,279 individuals) returned via Torkham, Spin Boldak, Islam Qala, and Bahramcha in the days prior, with UNHCR citing roughly 150,000 Afghans returned from Pakistan and Iran so far in 2026 by one measure — figures that vary across UN reporting depending on whether they cover year-to-date or cumulative since 2023.
